review_scope: One corrective isolated proposal review of R1; not implementation acceptance or adoption.

resolved_findings.resolution: The revised Markdown distinguishes expected uncertainty, which passes only the incomplete example's class check, from unexpected uncertainty on the positive or negative examples, which fails calibration. The JSON requires SEMANTIC_UNCERTAIN, REVIEW_REQUIRED and phase_complete=false for the incomplete example, explicitly excludes service and integrity errors, and requires all three class checks before UAR adoption.

reasoning: The stated probability regions are mutually exclusive: supported requires support >= 0.95 and contradiction <= 0.05; contradicted requires contradiction >= 0.95; uncertain requires contradiction < 0.95 and failure of the supported condition. Equality boundaries are explicit.

These regions classify the preserved observations consistently: positive support 0.80 / contradiction 0.02 remains unexpectedly uncertain and fails; negative support 0.01 / contradiction 0.99 is contradicted; incomplete support 0.01 / contradiction 0.4 is expected uncertainty. No historical result is upgraded.

The revision retains proposed_not_adopted status, the authoritative original fixture, an empty adoption record, unchanged model/channel and acceptance thresholds, immutable historical outcomes, and one post-adoption sample per changed example with bounded transient retries.

The receipt projections remain the same as those inspected in the first proposal review. The revision now specifies exact command-identity serialization and hash derivation; it continues to disclaim independent runner authentication.
The original positive support 0.80 failure remains unchanged. Readiness for operator review neither adopts the proposal nor authorizes new semantic samples.

inspection.observed_result: Exit zero; revised Markdown and JSON returned for source inspection.
inspection.prior_evidence: Original fixture, specification S3, calibration observations, evidence indexes and terminal command receipts were read in the first isolated proposal review in this same reviewer context.
limitations: No hash recomputation or production verification was performed.

The reviewed original specification and fixture establish the support and contradiction acceptance thresholds; they do not independently specify the complete implementation classifier. This review establishes internal consistency of the proposed class regions and their agreement with recorded observations, not a source audit of engine behavior.
The proposed revision remains unevaluated and its future semantic performance is unverified.
Cross-model independence and runner authenticity remain unverified.
